## Evidence per criterion

1. A row land commits exactly one new file and the regenerated index. `tests/land.rs`
   `a_paths_land_of_one_new_row_commits_that_file_and_the_regenerated_index_only ... ok`; the binary reports
   `23 passed; 0 failed`. Live: no new row has landed on main since phase 1 (87b1774de3), so no new-row commit
   exists to show. The nearest live land is d05102438d, a row edit that committed the row file and
   `plans/backlog.md` together (2 files). The first new row anyone lands through `fgos session write` will be
   the new-row example.
2. Every feeding land regenerates the index. `tests/land.rs`: `a_paths_land_of_a_discussion_commits_the_regenerated_index`,
   `a_plan_land_that_is_not_a_turn_to_done_touches_no_item`,
   `a_branch_land_whose_only_feeding_change_is_a_plan_status_edit_regenerates_the_index`,
   `a_branch_land_that_changes_a_plan_status_and_adds_a_row_commits_the_regenerated_index`,
   `a_paths_land_that_touches_no_index_feeding_path_leaves_the_index_alone`,
   `a_branch_land_that_touches_no_index_feeding_path_leaves_the_index_alone`: all `ok`.
3. A hand edit of the index cannot land. `tests/land.rs`: `a_paths_land_carrying_a_hand_edited_index_commits_the_generators_bytes`,
   `a_glob_in_the_paths_reaches_the_index_as_the_files_it_matches`,
   `a_branch_land_replaces_the_index_bytes_the_branch_itself_edited`: all `ok`.
4. The index lines come from the row files and the citing plans. `apps/fgos/tests/portfolio_check.rs`: `15 passed; 0 failed`.
5. The old write path is retired. `packages/session-host/rust/tests/permissions.rs`: `15 passed; 0 failed`;
   `apps/fgos/tests/session_write_publish.rs`: `6 passed; 0 failed`;
   `rg -n "generate_backlog_index" apps/fgos/src/wiring/session_write_publish.rs` returns nothing. In the
   secretary and supervisor skills, `plans/backlog.md` appears only as "the land door regenerates
   `plans/backlog.md` ... never edit the index" (fgos-secretary line 56, fgos-supervisor line 100).
6. One generator. `packages/portfolio/` holds only `contracts/`; the five `.mjs` files and their test are gone, and
   `rg "packages/portfolio/.*\.mjs" --glob '!plans/**'` returns nothing (exit 1). The behaviours their test proved are
   owned by named cases in `apps/fgos/tests/portfolio_check.rs` (`reports/phase-04-test-ownership.md`).
7. The combined tree is green, and the landed index equals the generator's output. Green: see the full gate above.
   No failure is from this plan. Index: the paths land ab24c1190c changed `plans/261128-0105-backlog-index-generated/plan.md`,
   a path that feeds the index. The door ran the generator, and the commit holds only that file. The door adds
   `plans/backlog.md` to a commit when the generator's bytes differ, and refuses the land on drift. So main's index
   equals the generator's output.
